examples.pie: gʷHrēi owis, kʷesyo wl̥Hnā ne ēst, eḱwōns espeḱet, oinom gʰe gʷr̥um woǵʰom weǵʰontm̥, oinomkʷe meǵam bʰorom, oinomkʷe ǵʰm̥enm̥ ōḱu bʰerontm̥.
examples.en: A sheep that had no wool saw horses, one of them pulling a heavy wagon, one carrying a big load, and one carrying a man quickly.

examples.pie: dʰh₁séy pr̥h₂wóm bʰoh₂góm ǵʰéwdoh₂. médʰu pl̥h₁nṓd péh₃tlōd péh₃oh₂. médʰu-kʷe nos h₁h₃sú sweh₂dú h₁syéh₁t.
examples.en: Let me pour the first share for the god. Let me drink the mead from the full cup. And may the mead be sweet in our mouths.

examples.pie: nu nos ń̥mr̥tōs déywōs dh₂pnóm gʷm̥té. sédesh₂ str̥h₃mé sweh₂dú médʰu ǵʰumé. sdté ǵéwsete méwdete-kʷe. h₁yós wos ǵʰéwdeti tósmey h₁wésuh₂ dh₃té.
examples.en: Now come, immortal gods, to our feast! We have spread the seats, we have poured the sweet mead. Sit down, taste, and rejoice! Whoever pours for you, to him give good things.

examples.pie: mélit wódr̥-kʷe kʷéroy dʰh₁dʰí. kʷérom ph₂wéni gʷʰr̥nudʰí. tríns dinóns yésēti. nu médʰu ǵʰuddʰí. pr̥h₂wóm péh₃tlom mē píph₃es dʰh₁séy tód dh₃dʰí.
examples.en: Put honey and water in the cauldron. Heat the cauldron at the fire. Let it boil for three days. Then pour the mead. Do not drink the first cup; give it to the god.

examples.pie: táwrom dʰǵʰyés drúsu h₁entér widóm. táwros. sékʷeto te? sékʷeto me drḗm-kʷe. túH HeHḱús. wiHrṓs nos táwrom péruti gʷʰnént. h₁éysōm ḱléwos méǵh₂.
examples.en: Yesterday I saw a wild bull among the trees. An aurochs! Did it follow you? It followed me, and I ran. You are swift! Last year our men slew an aurochs. Their fame is great.

examples.pie: kúdʰe toy súHes h₁sénti? drúsu h₁entér h₁sénti. wĺ̥kʷōs h₂én h₁sénti? h₁sénti. wl̥kʷíh₂s pórḱom péruti moréyet. nékʷti h₂én mē h₁éys. kʷsépi ne h₁éymi. ḱwónes súHn̥s ph₂sénti.
examples.en: Where are your pigs? They are among the trees. Are there wolves there? There are. Last year a she-wolf killed a piglet. Do not go there at night! At night I do not go. The dogs guard the pigs.

examples.pie: h₂éydʰe dyéwi dʰǵʰémi-kʷe h₁entér h₁éysi. deywóybʰos wékʷos bʰéresi. tóns-ge nos némos wédʰesi. h₁yós deywṓm stóygʰons wóydth₂e dṓm nos ph₂sdʰí. nu wédʰe léwke tóns h₁idʰé. tóns-kʷe nos h₂Hséh₂i sodéye.
examples.en: Fire, you go between Sky and Earth. You carry the word to the gods. You indeed bring them to our sacrifice. You who know the paths of the gods, guard our house. Now lead them here, bright one. And seat them at our hearth.

pie-lex-h2egjryos.gloss: campestral, field (attributive), of or relating to fields

examples.pie: h₂éǵr̥yos h₁ést dʰéh₁mn̥-kʷe ǵn̥néh₃t.
examples.en: He was of the field, and he knew the ordinance.

examples.pie: spḗr h₂éǵr̥yom h₂éngʷʰim widéh₁yeti.
examples.en: The sparrow sees the field snake.

examples.pie: nu ph₂wéni h₁épi légʰm̥. nu me léwke nékʷti ph₂sdʰí. póyḱos nos ḱóymom mē gʷm̥yéh₁t. h₂ŕ̥ǵre te h₂éyeri h₂éydʰoh₂.
examples.en: Now I have lain down near the fire. Now, bright one, guard me in the night. May the enemy not come to our village. At dawn let me kindle you, shining one.

examples.pie: h₂éyeri sth₂dʰí swóh₁-kʷe ǵʰóstoh₁ léwh₃e. h₂sowsóm dóru h₂Hséh₂i dʰh₁dʰí. péh₂wr̥ h₂idʰdʰí h₁íd-kʷe gʷr̥nHdʰí. h₁yód léwkt h₁erkʷóm gʷéHye. nu h₃éngʷn̥ péh₂wr̥ h₁n̥dó ǵʰudʰí.
examples.en: At dawn stand up and wash your hands. Put dry wood on the fire-altar. Kindle the fire and praise it. When it has become bright, sing the hymn. Then pour butter into the fire.

examples.pie: h₂éwsōs diwés dʰugh₂tḗr gʷémt. péh₂wr̥-kʷe h₂éyeri h₂idʰmé. lewkóm péh₂wr̥ h₂uséh₁ ḱóm bʰéwdʰt. h₂éwsōs h₁n̥gʷnís-kʷe dʰéǵʰōm lowkéyetes. h₂éwsōs nos h₁n̥gʷnís-kʷe h₁léwdʰins h₂léksoyh₁tām.
examples.en: Dawn, daughter of Sky, has come. And in the morning we have kindled the fire. The bright fire woke up with the Dawn. Dawn and Fire light up the earth. May Dawn and Fire protect our people!

examples.pie: h₁yós sḿ̥terosyo wésmn̥ kapyḗti só moysóm h₂éyos-kʷe déh₃eti.
examples.en: Whoever seizes the garment of one of the two shall give a ram and bronze.

examples.pie: h₂éyos h₁rudʰéh₁dʰi h₂éyos h₁ólos bʰuHdʰí. nu mē bʰéyds ḱléwos wiHrṓy h₁syéh₁t.
examples.en: Copper, become red! Copper, become an awl. Do not split. May there be fame for the man.

examples.pie: kʷís h₂eḱrós h₁ésti h₂éyos-kʷe ne h₁ésti? só ǵómbʰos h₁ésti.
examples.en: What is sharp and is not bronze? It is the tooth.

examples.pie: "ḱludʰí moi, pter werune!"
examples.en: "Hear me, father Werunos!"

examples.pie: (h₁)éḱwōs ewewkʷ, "ḱludʰí, h₂ówi! ḱḗrd h₂gʰnutoy widntbʰós: dʰǵʰémō(n), pótis, h₂wlnéh₂m h₂ówyom kʷnewti sébʰoy gʷʰérmom wéstrom; h₂éwibʰoskʷe h₂wlh₂néh₂ né h₁esti."
examples.en: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

examples.pie: stéwtor kéh₂nmn̥ gʷéHye dʰéh₁s-kʷe tód ḱléwtu.
examples.en: Praiser, sing the song, and let the god hear it!

examples.pie: kʷŕ̥mey h₁éǵʰs h₁néwn̥ wr̥míbʰis ḱóm gʷh₂dʰí. kʷŕ̥mey snéh₁wōr mosgʰṓd ih₂dʰí. wórmey mḗms sn̥h₁wénbʰos h₁idʰí. nu skéwHtim mémsos sérpe. kʷŕ̥mey soksóm skuHtéys litdʰí. nu kʷŕ̥mey h₂én mr̥dʰí h₂éti-kʷe mē gʷéms.
examples.en: Go out, worm, with nine worms! Go, worm, from the marrow into the sinews! Go, worm, from the sinews into the flesh! Now crawl from the flesh into the skin! Go away, worm, from the skin into the stone! Now die there, worm, and do not come back!

examples.pie: dinóy dyḗm pér stéygʰeti nékʷti-kʷe dʰéǵʰōm Hn̥dʰí h₁éyti. h₁ésyo h₃ókʷ ḱubʰróm h₁ím-kʷe kʷis ne spéḱyeti. h₂éǵrons gʷʰr̥néwti wódr̥-kʷe h₂sowséyeti. kʷís h₁éy? sóh₂wl̥.
examples.en: By day he walks across the sky, and at night he goes under the earth. His eye is bright, and no one looks at him. He warms the fields and dries the water. Who is he? The sun.

examples.pie: pḱéws moy kéh₂nmn̥ gʷéHye. gʷówes h₂éǵrom h₂ewsér h₁éǵʰs h₁yénti. sweh₂dú gʰréh₁mn̥ gʷr̥h₃ónti albʰóm-kʷe h₂mélǵos dédh₃n̥ti. dṓm wékʷsperoy nésontor mógʰewes-kʷe h₁íh₂n̥s sékʷontor. tód ḱubʰróm kéh₂nmn̥.
examples.en: Sing me a song about the cattle. The cows go out to the pasture at dawn. They eat the sweet grass and give white milk. At evening they return home, and the boys follow them. That is a beautiful song!

examples.pie: pótey moy h₂éwsōs swépnoy gʷémt. h₂éwsōs diwés dʰugh₂tḗr? ḱubʰréh₂ h₁ést h₂éndʰos-kʷe moy déh₃t. nu kúdʰe h₂éndʰos h₁ésti? h₁gérm̥ h₂éndʰos-kʷe néḱt. mē HréwdHs. h₂éwsōs toy téḱnom dh₃yéh₁t. deywṓs te ḱluwih₁ént.
examples.en: Husband, Dawn came to me in sleep. Dawn, the daughter of Sky? She was beautiful, and she gave me a flower. Where is the flower now? I woke up, and the flower vanished. Do not weep. May Dawn give you a child! May the gods hear you!

examples.pie: méh₂ter toy dʰéǵʰom ḱóm mórtom dedh₃més. h₁ím-kʷe toy ǵʰesr̥bʰís stége. ḱwn̥bʰós h₁ím mē déh₃s h₁ím wĺ̥kʷoybʰos ph₂sdʰí. tébʰye h₁én ssyéh₁t mē nésoyh₁to. nu h₁ésmey stĺ̥neh₂m dʰedʰh₁més. h₁ésyo-kʷe h₁nómn̥ mē n̥ḱyéh₁t.
